title: Video tile pairing is now available on Google Meet mobile to improve accessibility for users and language interpreters
facebook: If you ever need to follow a language interpreter during video calls, Google Meet on mobile now lets you keep their tile next to the speaker so you don't have to keep switching views. It's a simple accessibility upgrade that makes multitasking much easier. https://aiworldhq.com/article/google-s-new-phone-features-voice-built-docs-and-side-by-side-meet-til #GoogleMeet #Accessibility
image_idea: A smartphone screen showing a Google Meet call with two video tiles side by side, one showing a speaker and the other an interpreter
